column1: # linux-surface kernel releases the DKMS packages are generated for. One line per release tag of
# linux-surface/linux-surface. The generator rebuilds each line's source exactly as that release's
# package was built, and checks every pin:
#   tag          the release tag (debian-* or arch-*; the part before the first "-" is the kind)
#   release      `uname -r` of that kernel (checked against the header package in CI)
#   stable       the kernel.org stable version of the tarball
#   commit       the linux-surface commit the tag points to (patches/<series>, pkg/<kind>/kernel)
#   tarball      sha256 of linux-<stable>.tar.xz from cdn.kernel.org (kernel.org's sha256sums.asc)
#   distpatch    arch: sha256 of archlinux/linux's linux-v<stable>-archN.patch.zst; debian: -
